about_the_game:
Welcome to Pine Hollow Trailer Park

Six trailers. One newcomer. And a nightly visitor no one dares to speak of.

You've just moved in. During the day, life seems ordinary: take out the trash, fix the wiring, chat with neighbors on their porches. The people here are strange, but friendly… until night falls.

Something comes every night.
The lights flicker. Sirens echo through the fog. Silhouettes appear outside the window. Scratching at the door.
The TV turns on by itself.
And by morning — one neighbor might be gone.

No one wants to talk about it. But you can feel it: he’s real.
He’s watching.
He’s close.
And each night, he gets closer.


Features:

  • Psychological VHS/PSX-style horror in first person

  • Focus on atmosphere and exploration, not combat

  • Each night grows more tense as neighbors begin to disappear

  • One trailer park. Six residents. And something stalking in the fog

  • For fans of Paratopic, Lost in Vivo, Fear the Spotlight, Mundaun

short_description: Seven days. Seven nights. Six trailers. One new resident. Help your neighbors during the day and survive their screams at night. And only the siren's scream dilutes the sound...
